_comment: MAGIC v3 (design doc v3; designer session 2026-08-28). Every spell has a 'level' 1-5; its COST IS COMPUTED (level x 2 + 1 = 3/5/7/9/11 SP) — never add a 'cost'. WHO CASTS: 'classes' (ids from classes.json), gated by character level (spell level 1 at char 1-3, 2 at 4-7, 3 at 8-11, 4 at 12-15, 5 at 16-20). Wizards keep a SPELLBOOK from level 1 (classes.json 'spellbook'): they start with a kit, STUDY one common spell at set levels, and copy scrolls in. Priests know every common prayer; 'rare' prayers arrive as revelations (classes.json 'revelation_levels'). 'rare': true on an arcane spell = scroll-only lore (never studied — found on a scroll and copied in, or picked at the fork if it was already in the book). 'scroll': true = the engine makes a 'scroll_<id>' item (items.json 'scroll_values' ladder by level, 'rare_multiplier'); or {"value": N, "tier": T} to set them. Any caster may read a scroll of their OWN school once in battle (I menu, 0 SP, up to max spell level + 1) — arcane hands arcane scrolls, divine voices prayer-scrolls (opened 2026-08-31 for the shop's Cure Light Wounds; a prayer-scroll can never be COPIED — only a spellbook copies, and only arcane words take ink). FIELDS: stat = ability whose modifier boosts the spell (int = arcane, wis = divine); type = damage | heal | buff | afflict | cure | raise; range/area in battle squares (area 1 = a 3x3 burst, 2 = 5x5, "all" = every foe on the field, range 0 = centered on the caster). Damage spells never miss: each target rolls a save (d20 + bonus vs DC 10 + spell level + caster's stat mod) — 'save' names the resisting ability; success = half damage; auto = true means no save at all. Damage bursts do NOT spare your friends (afflictions touch only foes). 'condition': {id, rounds} lands on targets that FAIL their save. AFFLICT = no damage, just the condition (save or suffer) — it honors 'area', and 'only_family': ["undead", ...] skips everyone else. 'double_vs': a monster family that takes double total damage (like Ancient weapons). 'drain': 0.5 = that fraction of damage dealt heals the caster. BUFFS: targets = self | ally (aim at one hero) | allies (the whole living party); fields hit, dmg, ac, saves, attacks (extra attacks per round), absorb (dice — a shield that drinks that much damage first), bonus_damage {dice, element} on every weapon hit, hidden (= the thief's Vanish), resist (elements, or "all" — half damage), immune_conditions; 'rounds' makes it timed (absent = the whole battle). Every buff wears its NAME in the combat math. HEAL: 'dice' to one ally at the crosshair, or targets 'allies' for the whole party; 'cures' also strips conditions. CURE: 'cures': [ids] or "all", optional dice. RAISE: a FALLEN ally rises with 'hp' (fraction of max). SCALE (caster-level growth, named 'caster level' in the log): {"per_levels": N, "max": M, and ONE of dice | flat | rounds | extra_targets | ac | area} — one step every N caster levels past the level the spell unlocked at (1/4/8/12/16), at most M steps. Magic Missile's extra_targets fires more darts at the nearest other foes. DAMAGE GUIDELINE (doc): ~2d6 per spell level. ALL numbers are CONTENT-FLAG proposals — rename, retune, add, and cut freely! VISUALS: optional "fx" — {"kind": bolt | beam | lightning | burst | sparkle | wisp, "color": hex, "burst": fire | frost | holy}. SOUND: fx "sound": fire | frost | lightning | light | arcane | sonic | cloud | web (heals and buffs are automatic); fire/frost/lightning/poison also decide which worn resistances guard a hero caught in the blast. | LANE SPELLS (2026-08-29, companion doc v1 — Spellblade & Stoneshaper): a spell with 'lane' belongs to that level-5 lane of its class (the fixed-list 'magic': 'lane' model in classes.json) — known automatically as its level opens; before the fork a hero knows only the creation gift's spell (Spellblade) or the class's 'starting_spells' (classes.json — the Stoneshaper's Skin of Stone); at the fork the list becomes the lane's, and an active Stance of a swapped-out spell is exchanged for the lane's version free. PLAYTEST REVISION v1.1 (2026-08-30): the four level-1 lane spells are STANCES — 'stance': N = a flat N SP to cast (1) and the buff lasts UNTIL THE NEXT FULL REST (camp or inn), through every fight on the way; castable on the map from the spellbook screen (B) or in battle as usual. A stance never takes 'rounds'. Levels 2-5 are SURGES at the standard level x 2 + 1 cost (5/7/9/11), battle-scoped as before. NEW BUFF RIDERS: 'reduce' N (every blow loses N damage), 'halve' (every wound halved), 'reflect' 0.5 (that fraction of melee damage taken is thrown back at the attacker), 'lifesteal' 0.25 (that fraction of weapon damage dealt heals you), 'auto_hit' (weapon attacks cannot miss), 'immune_conditions' may be true (all) or a list of condition ids, 'once_per_rest' (castable once until a full rest). All numbers here are Claude's PROPOSALS under the doc's descriptions — retune freely. CONTENT FLAGS: Blooded Steel's element is fixed (fire) where the doc says 'chosen'; Ward of Kinship resists all four elements where the doc says 'a chosen one'; Warden's Aria/Avatar of Stone block all afflictions where the doc says 'one chosen type'. | ENCHANT RIDER (2026-08-31, designer's magic-to-hit ruling): a buff with 'enchant': true makes the target's weapon count as ENCHANTED while it holds — it bites magic_to_hit monsters (Blooded Steel = the Spellblade's early self-only answer; Enchant Weapon = the Wizard's later any-ally answer; divine gets no version — prayers attack instead).

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: A dart of force that never misses — more darts as you grow

lesser_fireball.name: Flame Burst
lesser_fireball.description: A burst of flame — it does not spare your friends!

poison_dart.name: Poison Dart
poison_dart.description: A sliver of venom — the wound is small, the poison is not

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: A soft word — the weak-willed in the burst slump where they stand, until something hurts them

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: A disc of force before you — +3 AC and it drinks the first blows

ray_of_enfeeblement.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
ray_of_enfeeblement.description: Strength runs out of the target like water — Weakened (−2 hit, −2 damage)

frost_lance.name: Frost Lance
frost_lance.description: A spear of killing cold for one foe

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.description: A ringing crack — everything in the burst rattles; constructs come apart

web.name: Web
web.description: Sticky strands fill the burst — the caught fight at half pace (Slowed)

paralyze.name: Hold
paralyze.description: Lock a creature's limbs — it loses its next turns

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.description: One ally fades from sight until they strike — exactly the potion, on demand

witchfire.name: Witchfire
witchfire.description: Green flame that clings and clings

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: The real thing — a roaring sphere of fire

enchant_weapon.name: Enchant Weapon
enchant_weapon.description: One ally's weapon shines with arcane edge: +1 to hit, and it bites foes only magic can touch, this battle

stinking_cloud.name: Stinking Cloud
stinking_cloud.description: A retching green fog, 5×5 — everything inside fights feebly (Weakened)

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: The party moves between heartbeats — an extra attack each turn for 3 rounds

vampiric_touch.name: Vampiric Touch
vampiric_touch.description: Steal life through a bare hand — half the harm heals you

ice_storm.name: Ice Storm
ice_storm.description: Hail like fists — the survivors move as if through syrup (Slowed)

hold_monsters.name: Hold Monsters
hold_monsters.description: The Hold, thrown wide — a whole knot of foes stands frozen

arcane_aegis.name: Arcane Aegis
arcane_aegis.description: A shimmering globe over the party — +2 AC and +2 on every save this battle

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.description: A piece of the night sky, called down on a 5×5

meteor_swarm.name: Meteor Swarm
meteor_swarm.description: Burning stones from a torn sky, 5×5

disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
disintegrate.description: What it touches, mostly, stops being

wail_of_the_banshee.name: Wail of the Banshee
wail_of_the_banshee.description: A scream from the far side, centered on you — everything near falters (Frightened)

mantle_of_storms.name: Mantle of Storms
mantle_of_storms.description: Every party blow carries a stroke of lightning (+1d6) this battle

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.description: One bolt, every foe on the field — the Archmage's answer to a crowded room

holy_bolt.name: Holy Bolt
holy_bolt.description: A lance of light — the dead burn twice as bright

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: The party strikes truer: +1 to hit

cure_poison.name: Cure Poison
cure_poison.description: Draws the venom out of one ally, and mends a little

turn_undead.name: Turn Undead
turn_undead.description: Brandish the symbol — the dead in the burst cower and strike feebly (Frightened; the living are untouched)

aura_of_courage.name: Aura of Courage
aura_of_courage.description: A calm that settles on the whole party — +2 on every save this battle

searing_ray.name: Searing Ray
searing_ray.description: Focused daylight, hot enough to judge — the dead burn twice

battle_hymn.name: Battle Hymn
battle_hymn.description: A marching song with teeth: +1 damage

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.description: One ally walks inside a ward of light — +2 AC this battle

spirit_guardian.name: Spirit Guardian
spirit_guardian.description: An unseen warden beside one ally — +1 AC, and it drinks 2d8 of the blows meant for them

prayer.name: Prayer
prayer.description: The party fights as if watched over: +1 to hit, +1 damage

pillar_of_light.name: Pillar of Light
pillar_of_light.description: A column of noon on one foe — the dead burn twice

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: One word, and every wound in the party eases

exorcism.name: Exorcism
exorcism.description: The unclean in the burst are cast out (undead and outsiders only) — and left Frightened

lesser_restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser_restoration.description: Shakes an ally loose of paralysis, sleep, webbing, weakness, fear or blindness — and mends a little

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.description: A flash of noon across a 5×5 — the dead burn twice, and everything is left Blinded

wrath_of_heaven.name: Wrath of Heaven
wrath_of_heaven.description: The sky opens. It is not pleased.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.description: Venom, fear, paralysis — all of it, gone from one ally, and 2d8 mended

aegis_of_the_faithful.name: Aegis of the Faithful
aegis_of_the_faithful.description: The whole party inside the ward — +2 AC and +2 on every save this battle

chains_of_light.name: Chains of Light
chains_of_light.description: Bands of light bind a knot of foes — Paralyzed

flame_strike.name: Flame Strike
flame_strike.description: A pillar of holy fire on a 3×3 — it does not spare your friends

holy_word.name: Holy Word
holy_word.description: A syllable of the first language — and the target stands Paralyzed

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.description: Not today — a fallen ally stands again at half health

sanctified_ground.name: Sanctified Ground
sanctified_ground.description: For 3 rounds nothing foul takes hold of the party — every element halved, no affliction lands

dawn_of_mercy.name: Dawn of Mercy
dawn_of_mercy.description: The first light of a new day on the whole party — 6d8 to everyone, every affliction gone

edge_of_dawn.name: Edge of Dawn
edge_of_dawn.description: The blade-verse, a Stance: +1 to hit and +1 damage until your next full rest — 1 SP

blooded_steel.name: Blooded Steel
blooded_steel.description: Your weapon runs with fire: +1d6 fire on every hit this battle — and the blade bites what mundane steel cannot

storm_of_blows.name: Storm of Blows
storm_of_blows.description: One more strike every turn for 3 rounds

deathless_fury.name: Deathless Fury
deathless_fury.description: +3 to hit, +3 damage, and a quarter of every wound you deal returns as your own blood, for 3 rounds

eclipse_blade.name: Eclipse Blade
eclipse_blade.description: For 2 rounds your blade cannot miss and lands +5 harder

aegis_of_dawn.name: Aegis of Dawn
aegis_of_dawn.description: The ward-verse, a Stance: +1 AC and +1 on every save until your next full rest — 1 SP

glimmering_veil.name: Glimmering Veil
glimmering_veil.description: A veil of light that drinks the first blows (2d8) this battle

iron_resolve.name: Iron Resolve
iron_resolve.description: +3 on every save and no fear can touch you, for 4 rounds

bastion_veil.name: Bastion Veil
bastion_veil.description: +3 AC, and half of every melee wound you take is thrown back at the attacker, for 3 rounds

wardens_aria.name: Warden's Aria
wardens_aria.description: For 2 rounds every wound is halved and no affliction can take hold

skin_of_stone.name: Skin of Stone
skin_of_stone.description: Your skin grays to granite, a Stance: +1 AC until your next full rest — 1 SP

mind_of_the_mountain.name: Mind of the Mountain
mind_of_the_mountain.description: +3 on every save and nothing can weaken you, this battle

heart_of_granite.name: Heart of Granite
heart_of_granite.description: +3 AC and every blow loses 2 damage, for 3 rounds

avatar_of_stone.name: Avatar of Stone
avatar_of_stone.description: For 2 rounds you are the mountain: every wound halved, no affliction can take hold

stonekins_blessing.name: Stonekin's Blessing
stonekins_blessing.description: One ally stands a little stonier, a Stance: +1 AC until your next full rest — 1 SP

circle_of_endurance.name: Circle of Endurance
circle_of_endurance.description: The whole party gains a stony second wind (1d8 absorbed) this battle — once per rest

ward_of_kinship.name: Ward of Kinship
ward_of_kinship.description: One ally takes half damage from fire, frost, lightning, and poison this battle

bulwark_of_the_clan.name: Bulwark of the Clan
bulwark_of_the_clan.description: The whole party: +1 AC and +1 on every save for 3 rounds

song_of_the_deep_roots.name: Song of the Deep Roots
song_of_the_deep_roots.description: For 2 rounds the whole party halves every element and no affliction takes hold

waybread.name: Waybread
waybread.description: Elven travel-bread: the party gains 1d6 absorbed damage and +1 on every save this battle

hunters_eye.name: Hunter's Eye
hunters_eye.description: Nothing hides from the hunter: the party strikes truer (+1 to hit) this battle
hunters_eye._comment: CONTENT FLAG: the doc says 'reveal hidden and invisible foes' — no monster hides yet, so for now it is a party +1 to hit; rework when hidden foes exist.

healing_herbs.name: Healing Herbs
healing_herbs.description: A poultice of wild herbs: one ally heals 1d8

snare.name: Snare
snare.description: A snare of root and cord: one foe is Slowed for 3 rounds

cloak_of_the_wild.name: Cloak of the Wild
cloak_of_the_wild.description: You are the brush and the shadow — unseen until you strike
